text: 10 OVERDOSAGE Clinical consequences of overdose with Gadoteridol Injection have not been reported. The safety of Gadoteridol Injection has been tested in clinical studies using doses up to 0.3 mmol/kg and no clinical consequences related to increasing dose have been observed to date. Gadoteridol can be removed by hemodialysis [see Use in Specific Populations ( 8.6 ) and Clinical Pharmacology ( 12.3 )].
